checks.description: Stage registry discovered all EPIC 2 components

checks.description: Mode contract defines all 6 pipeline modes

checks.description: Dual-consent permission contract defined

checks.description: Safe defaults: all training operations disabled

checks.description: CLI foundation supports all modes and flags

checks.description: Dry-run mode validates without side effects
checks.expected: dry_run=true skips all scientific actions, returns permission blocks
checks.actual_value: dry_run flag passed through config, stages skip on dry_run=true

checks.description: Stage order is acyclic (dependency graph valid)

checks.description: AtomicWriter prevents partial file writes

checks.description: Checkpoint writing after each stage

checks.description: model_monitor.py implements core monitoring capabilities
checks.expected: 2130 lines covering schema, quality, drift, prediction drift, artifact integrity

checks.description: Baseline immutability: hash computed before and after
checks.expected: SHA256 of baseline matches pre/post monitoring

checks.description: Governance: auto_retrain=false always enforced
checks.expected: Config check blocks auto_retrain=true at startup, exit 30
checks.actual_value: run_monitor() checks auto_retrain and auto_update_baseline, returns exit 30

checks.description: Artifact integrity: SHA256 verification of package artifacts
checks.expected: All artifacts in artifact_manifest.json verified
checks.actual_value: Artifact integrity PASS in test run

checks.description: Schema monitoring: required fields, unexpected fields, duplicates
checks.expected: Schema check produces blockers for missing required fields
checks.actual_value: Missing required fields produce BLOCKER severity alerts

checks.description: Data quality monitoring: empty batch, Inf/NaN, duplicates
checks.expected: Empty batch produces exit 14 blockers

checks.description: Numeric drift: PSI with fixed baseline bins
checks.expected: PSI uses baseline-defined bin edges, never recomputed from current
checks.actual_value: compute_psi() uses baseline bin edges from config

checks.description: Categorical drift: TVD with null-safe handling
checks.expected: TVD = 0.5 * sum(|p_cur - p_exp|), null baseline treated as unseen

checks.description: Prediction drift: mean, std, clipped rate, near-zero rate, PSI
checks.expected: Prediction drift computed independently of labels

checks.expected: No implicit performance computation in Phase 3
